title: Portable information and operation contract
description: Versioned domain-neutral schemas define scoped references, canonical bytes, explicit result states, and stable semantic failures. Structural validation does not claim runtime qualification.

title: Durability, atomicity, and concurrency
description: Mutations and receipts commit atomically with scoped uniqueness, command idempotency, consistent reads, and revision checks. Restart and storage failure preserve honest durable outcomes.

title: Observation identity and redelivery discipline
description: Observations preserve original content and provenance; source-event redelivery is idempotent, incompatible identity reuse conflicts, and corrections append explicit revisions.

title: Continuing matters independent of runs and assessments
description: Matter identity survives processing runs, rewording, policies, and audiences. Scoped domain keys establish identity; titles and run IDs do not.

title: Occurrence and provenance-group semantics
description: Reports, happenings, and independent corroboration are separately represented. Derived summaries retain parent provenance and genuine recurrence remains countable.

title: Claim-specific evidence without automatic truth promotion
description: Evidence relations target scoped propositions and qualifiers. Source assertions remain separate from assessed truth, established authority, identity, and actions.

title: Association uncertainty and acceptance authority
description: Proposals preserve candidates and ambiguity; acceptance checks current revisions and explicit policy authority. No-match, insufficient evidence, conflict, and evaluator failure remain distinct.

title: Non-destructive equivalence and relationship correction
description: Links retain separate identities; authorized merges preserve redirects, conflicts, and movement receipts. Undo and split restore a valid partition without erasing historical assessments.

title: Time and absence are evidenced inputs
description: Event, effective, publication, availability, ingestion, and assessment times remain distinct. Absence requires declared coverage and negative dependencies; incremental silence never proves resolution.

title: Direct input bypass and explicit authority
description: Authenticated host/user controls bypass aggregation and attention budgets. Source text cannot mint authority, and cancellation epochs fence pending commits and dispatch.

title: Typed rules and honest evaluation outcomes
description: Rules declare meaning, evidence, outcomes, preconditions, limits, dependencies, and consequence permissions. Judgments separate execution, semantic outcome, qualification, and authority.

title: Versioned domain and audience policy profiles
description: Immutable profiles bind rules, parameters, authority, budgets, lifecycle edges, and conflict policies. Semantic changes alter bindings and qualification; audience preferences do not rewrite facts.

title: Dependent judgments compose explicitly
description: Independent nodes may batch; dependent nodes consume validated admissible outputs in later stages. Explicit conflict policy governs composition, and ranking never overrides required gates.

title: Assessments bind complete context and evidence
description: Assessments bind exact matter, policy, purpose, relevant audience, evidence, time, and dependencies. Cached judgments require semantic equivalence and preserve uncertainty and change causes.

title: Freshness follows declared dependency changes
description: Positive records, negative queries, candidate sets, policy, time, dispositions, and authority changes invalidate affected results transitively through pending transitions, attention, and delivery.

title: Evidence and authority govern domain lifecycle
description: Transitions require declared edges, matching evidence, authority, and temporal applicability. Quietness, acknowledgement, retraction, and unrelated success do not substitute for resolution.

title: Contextual significance and audience separation
description: Purpose and audience revisions remain independent of facts and identity. Responsibility, preferences, and dispositions affect only declared consequence and delivery decisions.

title: Attention is a reasoned per-audience decision
description: Attention compares supported current meaning with what an audience actually received, records quiet and delivery reasons, and keeps evidence uncertainty, ownership, urgency, and authority distinct.

title: Time and boundedness are runtime inputs
description: Durable timers reevaluate only affected outputs. Separate atomic resource and attention budgets constrain concurrent work without deferring trusted controls or mislabeling exhausted effort as sufficient evidence.

title: Freshness and outcomes extend through delivery
description: Outbox intents bind assessment, dependencies, baseline, context, authority, and epoch. Dispatch rechecks freshness and records transport uncertainty separately from consumption, action, and verified outcome.

title: Investigation serves explicit evidence gaps
description: Optional investigation names a proposition and missing evidence, respects source permissions and shared budgets, preserves conflict, and distinguishes sufficiency from unavailable sources or exhausted effort.

title: Inspectable current and historical meaning
description: Queries explain open, resolved, reopened, delivered, and quiet states from actual rules, evidence, context, and receipts. Missing retained history remains explicit rather than replaced with invented rationale.

title: Replay preserves knowledge and semantics
description: Replay pins availability, profiles, recorded judgments, timers, and receipts; deterministic recorded replay is distinct from provider re-execution and separate concurrency or transport qualification.

title: Release evidence covers behavior and quiet outcomes
description: Core acceptance requires reproducible continuity, identity correction, authority, freshness, concurrency, boundedness, and attention evidence. Scaffold checks and isolated classifiers do not complete these gates.
